nom: Wrinkles Schminkles Face, Neck & Décolletage Peel Pads

segments.dry: One reviewer says the pads helped a lot with dry skin, especially in winter.
segments.mature: Several reviewers describe themselves as older or focused on anti-aging use and report smoother, younger-looking, tighter-appearing skin with an easy routine.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly smoother texture, reduced fine lines, tighter-feeling skin, and a more youthful appearance, including one with deep wrinkles still hoping for further improvement; effects are described as noticeable within a few uses to one box.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports waking up with a more hydrated complexion after leaving the pads on overnight.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with lupus reports the pads help protect her face from small bumps and irritation; another notes zero irritation and no stinging or tingling.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer notes the pads helped with pores; no reports of new breakouts appear in the reviews.

aspects.libelle: Fast, visible results after few uses
Mixed enthusiasm despite doing the job

extraits.texte: I have deep wrinkles so it might take awhile to see any improvement or even a slight improvement. I am hoping for the best!!!
I love them. I have already reorders 3 more boxes. I definitely could tell my lighter lines looked so much better after a box. Over all face much better texture.

These peel pads work after just 1 application. I was nervous about the 'peel' nature of the pad but was given one as a gift and it leaves your skin so bright and clean. No aggressive stinging - it actually feels nice when you apply. It's become a daily part of my skin ritual and my face has never looked smoother. It's a way cheaper and in my opinion More effective than a facial and can be done right before bed. Highly reccomended!

These polishing pads are so awesome for exfoliating your skin. Plus they helped me with my pores. Truly love using them right now especially in the winter because I have so much dry skin these helped me out a lot!
Love this product! Have lupus and it helps so much to protect my face from little bumps from the lupus
I wore over night and woke up to a nice hydrated complexation
They're actually quite good if you like peel pads. I'm not too keen on them, but they do the job.
